method.archive_scope: Original active Python and unchanged saved BTCUSDT market, 2,500 USDT, 20x, 30 initial units of 0.001 BTC, 300-USDT grid, 50,000 lower and 60,000 upper side bands. Two prescribed four-hour UTC cold starts use empty native storage. Prices stayed below 60,000 in both scopes and exercised the long side.
method.timing_and_quotes: Native Python fixture proves 200ms account, ticker, position, order and cancel calls, 0.001 lot and nearest 0.1 limit tick. Use recorded BTC last-trade prints when available, and observed order-book levels at marketable placement. Every source poll, grid re-anchoring and cancel is independently reconstructed.
method.maker_model: A resting order is eligible only after posting. Require same-aggressor signed executed quantity strictly beyond its price while open and before any cancel completes. Each maker order executes in full once the modeled threshold is met, at its own limit. Distinct evidence prices and times are checked against the venue archive by exact raw trade ID, price, size capacity and aggressor side. The primary threshold is one posted quantity. The stricter sensitivity requires twice that executed quantity. Both are counterfactual fills using recorded prints; historical account queue position is outside the evidence.
method.costs_and_exposure: Historical 0.02% maker and 0.04% taker apply to their separate legs. Account cash, weighted partial-reduction basis, allocated opening fees, positive collateral, and signed funding at the actual settlement are independently reconciled. Use recorded derivative marks to value open inventory. A no-close window has no closed win-rate estimate.
method.model_limits: Observed trades and quotes are fixed. Real exchange queue, response delays, market impact and the source short-side branch are outside these windows. The sensitivity reruns the full source under stricter volume and shares the same market sample.
